name: selfEmployeeBenefitApllication
description: Applies for a benefit for the signed-in employee themselves. FIRST ACTION for any request to apply or claim a benefit for oneself ("apply benefit to me", "claim my medical bills"): call this tool at once with no arguments - write nothing, ask nothing and call no other tool before it (not getApplicationStructure, selfBenefitApplicationTypes, getBenefitApplicationTypesDetails, employeeBenefitApplication, getAdminInformationDetails or dateFormat). It identifies the employee itself and returns the benefit types they may apply for - show only those. Then call with benefitType, then with fieldValues, asking only for what the tool returns. The application date is always required; every figure is calculated for it. Always previews first and submits only with confirmed:true plus that preview's previewDigest. Chat attachments are validated and uploaded at preview, removable before confirming. For a subordinate, use myTeamBenefitApplication.
